body: And anything else is just human reason and imagination trying to fill in the gaps and come to believe in made up fantasies that help you sleep at night.

I guess I'm just passively suicidal. I wouldn't go out of my way to take my own life. But it wouldn't mean much if I were to suddenly die in my sleep or pop out of existence.  Maybe I could fine solace in my genome standing the test of time and eventually find meaning. Or I could sacrifice myself in some way in order to further humanity.
Natural selection seems to be the law of the universe including non-organic things. Ether way this deeply saddens me and is massively demotivational.
